svg.title: Sequential updating lands in the same place
svg.desc: Left: the prior, the half-way posterior and the final posterior. Right: the running posterior mean under three different orderings of the same forty outcomes.
svg.text: One tray, updated in two batches
The paths differ; the destination does not. Order is irrelevant here because the forty seeds are exchangeable under this model.
Left: Beta(2, 2), then Beta(16, 8) after fourteen of the first twenty, then Beta(28, 16) after twelve more of the next twenty.
